# Most Canadians Want Netflix, Disney to Pay for Local Content

Almost three in four Canadians say streaming giants such as Netflix Inc. and Walt Disney Co. should contribute financially to Canadian content creation, despite fierce US opposition to such a requirement.

A Nanos poll conducted on behalf of Bloomberg News found 73% of respondents supported subjecting streamers to the same rules imposed on Canadian broadcasters to fund Canadian content. That’s up from 67% in May 2022.
